system.description:
The guardians of the old forests: the Nalwood under Arikh Evergreen's Cabal, the Myllnoris woods and the Tanatharen.

  • Old-Growth Instinct: Advantage on Conceal checks in dense woodland. Your first attack from Conceal each encounter in woodland gets your Hunter's Edge in full, whatever the target.
    • 9th level: after an attack from Conceal in woodland, you may Conceal again as part of your movement.
  • Warden's Kinship: Advantage on checks to identify forest creatures, find paths through old forest, and deal with the druids of the Cabal.
